persona_summary.name: HT-075 Validator (non-persona session)
persona_summary.session_type: story validation — not a full persona simulation

executive_summary.root_cause: Docker container was built with HT-072 topology-history code but NOT the HT-075 ghost synthesis code. The ghost service (topology_editor_ghost_service.py, domain/topology_history.py synthesize_ghost_placeholders) and ghost endpoints (/ghosts/{id}/recreate, /ghosts/{id}/map) are absent from the running container. Deleted device nodes are silently dropped from restored topologies instead of being preserved as ghost placeholders.
executive_summary.fix_required: Run: docker compose build && docker compose up -d — then re-validate

prioritized_issues.title: Ghost placeholder synthesis not deployed — deleted device nodes silently dropped on topology restore
prioritized_issues.action: HISTORY → select version with deleted devices → RESTORE SELECTED → confirm
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Create devices DeviceA and DeviceLive, place both on a topology canvas, click SAVE VERSION
3. On the topology page, click HISTORY, select the saved version (contains both devices), click RESTORE SELECTED
4. Observe: canvas shows ONLY DeviceLive — DeviceA is silently absent, no ghost placeholder, no 'Deleted from inventory' label, no restore summary banner
prioritized_issues.expected: Canvas should show DeviceA as a dashed/muted ghost node labeled 'DeviceA (Deleted from inventory)', with a restore summary banner and Admin/Contributor action buttons (Recreate / Map)
prioritized_issues.actual: Deleted device node is completely absent from canvas after restore. No ghost placeholder. No restore summary banner. No reconciliation actions.

api_evidence.ghost_endpoints_in_openapi_spec: NONE — /ghosts/** routes not registered in running container

prioritized_issues.title: No restore summary banner after topology restore — UI has no banner component or JS bridge for it
prioritized_issues.action: Restore a history entry via UI
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Perform any topology restore via HISTORY → RESTORE SELECTED
2. Observe: no informational banner appears above canvas after restore
prioritized_issues.expected: Banner: 'N deleted devices were preserved as ghost placeholders — click a ghost node to Recreate or Map'
prioritized_issues.actual: No banner rendered anywhere on topology page after restore
prioritized_issues.note: Blocked by issue #1 — cannot evaluate independently until ghosts are synthesized
